simple.meaning: שִׁלֹחַ (Shilôach) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Nehemiah, Isaiah, beginning at Nehemiah 3:15. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, city.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שִׁלֹחַ through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
